svg.title: How an experiment runs
svg.desc: An experiment folder seeds a forge with the world at pinned releases. A coordinator wakes one agent per repository; each agent turn works on the forge in a sandbox, with pull requests, reviews and releases. An evaluator measures the forge's heads every two hours with downstream benchmarks the agents never see, for the held-out speedup. After the run, a checkpoint is collected into an evidence store by sim-analyzer and exported as a bundle, which the interactive simulation viewer at sim.swecraft.world shows.
